title: On Generalized Milnor Manifolds and Their Topological Complexity
summary: We introduce generalized Milnor manifolds (GMM), extending the classical Milnor manifolds over $\mathbb{R}$, $\mathbb{C}$, and $\mathbb{H}$. We compute their integral cohomology algebras in the complex and quaternionic cases and their mod-$2$ cohomology algebras in the real case. We compare GMM with partial flag manifolds, investigate when they are homotopy equivalent, and obtain a necessary and sufficient condition in the complex and quaternionic cases.
